en-US.description: Let any AI agent use your iPhone or Android phone from your computer, with you in the loop.
en-US.longDescription: Pinky lets any agent (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor or a script) operate a real iPhone or Android phone over MCP, while you watch on your computer, approve risky steps, take over and review what happened. Approvals are enforced by Pinky's gateway, not by instructions to the agent.
en-US.name: Pinky
en-US.releaseNotes: - Pinky on Android now shows a task's steps, approval cards and the phone's status in the app's language (Chinese or Japanese) instead of English.

zh-CN.description: 让任何 AI Agent 在你的电脑上操作 iPhone 或 Android 手机，关键一步由你决定。
zh-CN.longDescription: Pinky 让任何 Agent（Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Cursor，或者一段脚本）通过 MCP 操作真实的 iPhone 或 Android 手机。你在电脑上看着它干活，有风险的步骤由你批准，随时可以接管，事后还能回看。审批由 Pinky 的网关执行，不靠给 Agent 的指令。
zh-CN.releaseNotes: - Android 上的 Pinky 做任务时，悬浮胶囊、任务页和「活动」里的步骤、批准卡片和手机状态现在跟随应用的语言显示，不再是英文。
